Mapping of IUMPR ratio on internal data element If the DemInternalDataElement is set to DEM_IUMPR , the Dem shall use the DTC assigned IUMPR value in SAE J1979-2 format as value for this internal data element.

Mapping of DTR value on internal data element If the DemInternalDataElement is set to DEM_DTR , the Dem shall use the DTC assigned DTR value in SAE J1979-2 format as value for this internal data element.

Mapping of Monitor Activity Data on internal data element If the DemInternalDataElement is set to DEM_MONITOR_ACTIVITY_DATA , the Dem shall support per DTC the Monitor Activity Data according to SAE J1979-2 and map it as value for this internal data element.
Support of PID 0xF501 data The Dem shall calculate the data for PID 0xF501 and provide the data within the parameter PIDF501value of Dem_DcmReadDataOfPIDF501 .

Support of Monitor Activity Denominator The Dem shall calculate the data for ITID "Monitor Activity Denominator" and provide it in the parameter of DataValueBuffer of the API Dem_DcmGetInfoTypeValue79 .
Legislated FreezeFrame support The Dem shall support legislated freeze frames according to SAE J1979-2 [18].

Data content of legislated freeze frames If a DTC assigned to the primary fault memory is configured and refers to a DemFreezeFrameRecordNumber with 0x00 and 0xF0, the Dem shall sample the legislated freeze frame based on the data configured via DemUDSOBDFreezeFrameClassRef .

Selection of 3 byte OBD DTCs If Dem_SelectDTC is called with DTCFormat equal to DEM_DTC_FORMAT_OBD_- 3BYTE , the Dem shall select only DTCs based on the 3 byte OBD Format defined by DemDtcValue3Byte .

API behavior on not supported OBD 3 byte DTC If DemSupportedObdUdsDtcSeparation is not configured or is set to FALSE and any Dem API having DTC format as a parameter is called with DTCFormat set to DEM_ DTC_FORMAT_OBD_3BYTE , the Dem shall report the Det DEM_E_PARAM_DATA .

Selecting OBD 3 Byte DTCs for readiness group filter If Dem_SetDTCFilterByReadinessGroup is called with DTCFormat equal to DEM_DTC_FORMAT_OBD_3BYTE and DemSupportedObdUdsDtcSeparation is set to True, the Dem shall use the DTCs configured via DemDtcValue3Byte as filter target.

Selecting UDS DTCs for readiness group filter If Dem_SetDTCFilterByReadinessGroup is called with DTCFormat equal to DEM_DTC_FORMAT_UDS and DemSupportedObdUdsDtcSeparation is set to FALSE, the Dem shall use the 3-byte UDS DTC configured via DemDtcValue as filter target.

Selecting not supported DTC format for readiness group filter If Dem_SetDTCFilterByReadinessGroup is called with DTCFormat equal to DEM_DTC_FORMAT_UDS and DemSupportedObdUdsDtcSeparation is set to TRUE, the Dem shall report the Det DEM_E_PARAM_DATA .

Selecting OBD 3 Byte DTCs with extended data records If Dem_SetDTCFilterByExtendedDataRecordNumber is called with DTCFormat equal to DEM_DTC_FORMAT_OBD_3BYTE and DemSupportedObdUdsDtcSeparation is set to True, the Dem shall use the DTCs configured via DemDtcValue3Byte as filter target.

Selecting UDS DTCs with extended data records If Dem_SetDTCFilterByExtendedDataRecordNumber is called with DTCFormat equal to DEM_DTC_FORMAT_UDS , the Dem shall use the 3-byte UDS DTC configured via DemDtcValue as filter target.

If DemIUMPRDenGroup is configured as DEM_IUMPR_DEN_- 500MILL , the Dem shall increment the denominator of the ratio depending on DEM_ IUMPR_DEN_COND_500MI_CMPL a maximum of once per driving cycle.

If DemIUMPRDenGroup is configured as DEM_IUMPR_DEN_COLDSTART , the Dem shall increment the denominator of the ratio depending on DEM_ IUMPR_DEN_COND_COLDSTART_CMPL a maximum of once per driving cycle.
If DemIUMPRDenGroup is configured as DEM_IUMPR_DEN_EVAP , the Dem shall increment the denominator of the ratio depending on DEM_IUMPR_DEN_COND_EVAP_CMPL a maximum of once per driving cycle.

If DemIUMPRDenGroup is configured as DEM_IUMPR_DEN_PHYS_API , the Dem shall increment the denominator of the ratio depending on DEM_ IUMPR_GENERAL_INDIVIDUAL_DENOMINATOR a maximum of once per driving cycle and shall consider monitor specific conditions only for the cycle the Release operation was called in.

The function Dem_J1939DcmGetNextFreezeFrame shall set the parameter J1939DTC to the corresponding J1939DTC value (refer DemDTCAttributes for details).
The function Dem_J1939DcmGetNextFreezeFrame shall set the parameter OccurenceCounter to the corresponding occurrence counter value.
If the occurrence counter is above +126 (0x7E), the function Dem_J1939DcmGetNextFreezeFrame shall set the parameter OccurenceCounter to +126 (0x7E).

If DemIUMPRDenGroup is configured as DEM_IUMPR_DEN_CSERS the Dem shall increment the denominator of the ratio depending on DEM_IUMPR_DEN_COND_CSERS a maximum of once per driving cycle.

Support of DTCExtendedDataRecordNumber 0xFE The Dem shall always support DTCExtendedDataRecordNumber 0xFE for the primary fault memory in case at least one extended data record in the range 0x90-0x9F is supported (which means regulatory emission OBD is used) and return all regulated emission OBD stored extended data records in the range of 0x90 to 0x9F.

Support of DTCExtendedDataRecordNumber 0xFF in primary fault memory The Dem shall always support DTCExtendedDataRecordNumber 0xFF for the primary fault memory and return all stored extended data records in the range of 0x01 to 0xEF.

Support of DTCExtendedDataRecordNumber 0xFF in user defined fault memory The Dem shall always support DTCExtendedDataRecordNumber 0xFF for an user defined fault memory and return all stored extended data records in the range of 0x01 to 0xFE.

Indication of Ongoing Non-Volatile Memory Storage The function Dem_InitAllNvmBlocksGetResult shall return E_PENDING if the function Dem_InitAllNvmBlocks was called successfully, but storing to non-volatile memory is still ongoing and not yet finished.
